about: Namesakes split by hand: the tree joins people by name, so these are kept apart section by section (see annotate/merge.py, apply_namesakes).

groups.name: Scylla
groups.about: Daughter of King Nisus of Megara who betrays her father for love of Minos and is turned into the bird Ciris.

groups.name: Scylla, the sea monster loved by Glaucus
groups.about: Maiden or nymph who spurns Glaucus, is transformed by Circe into a monster ringed with dogs, and becomes a rock.

groups.name: Pallas
groups.about: Pallas Athena/Minerva, the virgin warrior goddess of wisdom and weaving, daughter of Jupiter, called both Pallas and Minerva by Ovid.

groups.name: Pallas, father of Clytus and Butes
groups.about: The Athenian Pallas, a mortal father of Clytus and Butes, whose family is among the Athenian visitors.
